info.name: Munshi
info.description: Munshi’s read-only integration feed, its public API v1 (from packages/contracts/openapi.json) and the PayPal sandbox calls its adapter makes. Built by integrations/postman/build.ts; edit that, not this file. Data on the sample shops is synthetic; PayPal is the sandbox.

item.name: Integration feed
item.description: GET /api/integrations/v1/feed: one sample shop’s PayPal links, the PayPal payments its books do not show yet, and its findings. Read only. Bearer MUNSHI_INTEGRATION_SECRET (integrationSecret); anything else is a bare 404.

exec: pm.test("names the shop with its sample label", () => { pm.expect(f.shop.slug).to.eql(pm.variables.get("shop")); pm.expect(f.shop.label).to.include("Sample"); });
pm.test("each link's id is its link and its state", () => f.links.forEach((l) => pm.expect(l.id).to.eql(l.linkId + ":" + l.state)));
pm.test("each link state is the app's own", () => f.links.forEach((l) => pm.expect(["asked", "sent", "paid", "recorded", "failed", "cancelled"]).to.include(l.state)));
pm.test("a wrong key is a bare 404", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(""); });

item.name: Public API v1
item.description: Every operation in packages/contracts/openapi.json. Public reads need no key. Site writes take a site’s publishable key and change a real request queue: run them only against a local or sample site. The owner’s operations are specified and deferred: they answer 404.

item.name: PayPal sandbox
item.description: The calls Munshi’s PayPal adapter makes (packages/adapters/payments/paypal.ts), in its order, against PayPal’s sandbox only: test money, nothing real moves. paypalClientId and paypalClientSecret are a sandbox app’s. Each run makes a new invoice number and request id, and the last step cancels the invoice.
